name: webflow-redirects
description: Review supplied Webflow 301 redirect maps for wildcard/path precedence, encoding, chains, loops and destination issues. Preserve existing rules and prepare a merged two-column CSV from a complete current export and approved changes. Check destination paths and domains against supplied information and review returned import-error CSVs.
